Senior Technical Program Manager — Payments
Company: Finlane (fintech scale-up)

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead cross-team delivery of our payments platform.
This is a hybrid role based in Barcelona, with 2 days a week in the office.

What you'll do
- Drive programs across 5 engineering teams from roadmapping to launch.
- Own stakeholder management with product, compliance and finance.
- Run agile delivery rituals and OKRs for the payments group.

What we're looking for
- 8+ years of experience in software delivery, including people management or tech lead experience.
- Strong program management and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience with payments or fintech.
- Hands-on knowledge of AWS and microservices.
- Fluent English.

Nice to have
- Experience with SQL and product analytics.
- Spanish.

Salary: €75,000 - €90,000 gross per year.
